name: メイドめいと
description: すくすく成長カビパン日記🐹💦

works.body:
Hello! I'm a big fan of your work and always enjoy seeing your wonderful art.
The sketchbook you shared recently was absolutely amazing! I especially love the cool and mysterious atmosphere in your illustrations; I'm always captivated by them.

While I adore your cool style, I was also really impressed by your pieces with a cute and soft atmosphere, like this one: https://x.com/jpgshining/status/1942622819785011260/photo/1
I think that style is truly wonderful as well.

I was wondering if it would be possible for me to commission an illustration from you in a similar cute style?
Please continue with Alice from Alice in Wonderland as the theme.

I know you must be very busy, but I would be grateful if you could consider my request.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,

https://x.com/jpgshining/status/1942622819785011260/photo/1

I read your comic.
I am a P who has the Nichika Defeat comic burned into my brain, so it stung like crazy. It was very good.

I would like to ask you if it would be possible to write an icon that can be used on Twitter, Discord, etc.
This is my first time using your service, and I would like to leave it to you if there is anything I am missing. (or reject it, please).

As for the character we would like you to draw, we are currently using the following icon, and we think that Alice in Wonderland would be a good choice as well.
(If you have any difficulty in drawing a different character, there is no problem at all.
https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/1186498767408656384/ti3CWipS_400x400.jpg

I am sorry that I have taken the liberty of going back to past tweets about the atmosphere, but I really liked the drawings around here. I think a similar touch would be wonderful.
https://x.com/jpgshining/status/1521478296533299200/photo/1

As for the format, I think it would be better if it were square, but I am not particular about it, so I would be happy to leave it to you.
Also, if possible, it would be very helpful if you could provide us with the difference between the two pictures, with and without the background.


Finally, we will continue to support you! I am also waiting for your cartoon!
Thank you very much.
